name: ts-package-rooting-module-move
body: `solution.component.ts-package-rooting` is implemented-by `ts.apg-tsfrontend.discovery.discoverPackages` and the Module `ts.apg-tsfrontend`; `solution.container.ts-frontend` is implemented-by the Module `ts.apg-tsfrontend`. TypeScript files are namespace segments (not Module nodes), so the package Module `ts.apg-tsfrontend` and `ts.apg-tsfrontend.identity.packageIdentity` are preserved while every moved function carries a file-namespace segment in its FQN. The tslib decomposition splits `scanner.ts` into a thin orchestrator plus seven sibling `.mjs` modules (declarations, discovery, emit, program, resolve, state, walk), placing `discoverPackages` in the `discovery` namespace.
